sub_graphs.title: EIP-225: Clique Block Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the block validation rules for Clique PoA consensus

nodes.label: Block Received
nodes.description: A new block has been received from the network or locally produced

nodes.label: Extract Signer from Signature
nodes.description: Recover signer address from ECDSA signature in extraData suffix (last 65 bytes)

nodes.label: Verify Signer is Authorized
nodes.description: Check if recovered signer is in the current authorized signer set

nodes.label: Signer Unauthorized
nodes.description: Block rejected - signer not in authorized set

nodes.label: Verify Signing Limit
nodes.description: Check signer hasn't signed more than 1 of last floor(N/2)+1 blocks

nodes.label: Signing Limit Exceeded
nodes.description: Block rejected - signer has signed too recently

nodes.label: Verify Block Timestamp
nodes.description: Check timestamp >= parent_timestamp + BLOCK_PERIOD (15s)

nodes.label: Timestamp Invalid
nodes.description: Block rejected - timestamp too early

nodes.label: Verify Extra Data Format
nodes.description: Check extraData has VANITY prefix (32 bytes) and SEAL suffix (65 bytes)

nodes.label: Verify Checkpoint Block
nodes.description: For epoch blocks: verify signer list in extraData, nonce=0, beneficiary=0

nodes.label: Block Valid
nodes.description: Block passes all Clique validation rules

external_entities.name: Peer Node
external_entities.description: Other nodes in the Clique network propagating blocks

sub_graphs.title: EIP-225: Clique Signer Voting Mechanism
sub_graphs.description: Models the voting process for adding/removing authorized signers

nodes.label: Vote Proposed in Block
nodes.description: Signer includes vote in block header (beneficiary + nonce)

nodes.label: Record Vote
nodes.description: Store vote: beneficiary address + AUTH(0xff..ff) or DROP(0x00..00)

nodes.label: Tally Votes for Beneficiary
nodes.description: Count votes for/against the beneficiary address

nodes.label: Check Majority Threshold
nodes.description: Check if votes >= floor(N/2) + 1 (SIGNER_LIMIT)

nodes.label: No Majority Reached
nodes.description: Vote recorded but threshold not met

nodes.label: Majority for Authorization
nodes.description: Majority votes to authorize - add signer

nodes.label: Majority for Deauthorization
nodes.description: Majority votes to drop - remove signer

nodes.label: Add Signer to Set
nodes.description: Add beneficiary to authorized signer set

nodes.label: Remove Signer from Set
nodes.description: Remove beneficiary from authorized signer set

nodes.label: Discard Related Votes
nodes.description: Clear all pending votes for the beneficiary

nodes.label: Signer Set Updated
nodes.description: Authorized signer set has been modified

edges.label: Signer includes vote in produced block

external_entities.name: Authorized Signer
external_entities.description: Current member of the authorized signer set proposing votes

sub_graphs.title: EIP-225: Clique Block Production
sub_graphs.description: Models the block production and signing process for authorized signers

nodes.label: Signer Ready to Produce
nodes.description: Authorized signer is ready to produce a block

nodes.label: Check In-Turn Status
nodes.description: Determine if signer is in-turn: block_number % N == signer_index

nodes.label: Signer In-Turn
nodes.description: This signer should produce the next block

nodes.label: Signer Out-of-Turn
nodes.description: Another signer has priority

nodes.label: Wait for Exact Timestamp
nodes.description: In-turn signer waits for parent_timestamp + BLOCK_PERIOD

nodes.label: Wait with Random Delay
nodes.description: Out-of-turn signer waits extra rand(N * 500ms)

nodes.label: Assemble Block
nodes.description: Create block with transactions, set difficulty (INTURN=2, NOTURN=1)

nodes.label: Sign Block Header
nodes.description: ECDSA sign header hash (excluding signature), append to extraData

nodes.label: Block Signed
nodes.description: Block is fully assembled and signed

nodes.label: Broadcast Block
nodes.description: Propagate signed block to network peers

sub_graphs.title: EIP-225: Clique Security Controls
sub_graphs.description: Models the security mechanisms preventing signer abuse

nodes.label: Malicious Signer Active
nodes.description: A compromised or malicious signer is attempting abuse

nodes.label: Enforce Signing Limit
nodes.description: Limit signer to 1 block per floor(N/2)+1 consecutive blocks

nodes.label: Block Spam Prevented
nodes.description: Malicious signer cannot flood with blocks

nodes.label: Reset Votes at Epoch
nodes.description: Discard all votes older than one epoch to prevent unbounded growth

nodes.label: Vote Spam Prevented
nodes.description: Vote tracking remains bounded

nodes.label: Verify 51% Threshold
nodes.description: Require majority (>50%) for signer set changes

nodes.label: Minority Takeover Prevented
nodes.description: Less than 51% of signers cannot change the signer set

nodes.label: Vote Out Malicious Signer
nodes.description: Honest signers vote to deauthorize compromised signer

nodes.label: Malicious Signer Removed
nodes.description: Compromised signer no longer in authorized set

ambiguities.text: The BLOCK_PERIOD is 'suggested' as 15 seconds but not mandated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BLOCK_PERIOD is a network configuration parameter that must be agreed upon at genesis. Different Clique networks may use different values.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'capable clients should be able to sync without requiring any previous state' at checkpoints is vague about what 'capable' means.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume checkpoints embed the complete signer list, allowing light clients to verify subsequent blocks without full history. 'Capable' refers to clients implementing checkpoint sync.

ambiguities.text: The specification doesn't define behavior when the signer set becomes empty.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is an invalid state that should never occur. Minimum signer count should be 1. Voting rules should prevent removing the last signer.

ambiguities.text: Cascading vote execution is mentioned but the exact order of execution when multiple proposals reach consensus simultaneously is unclear.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume only one proposal is executed per block (the beneficiary of the current block), and others execute when their beneficiary is explicitly voted on again.

implicit_assumptions.description: A majority (>50%) of authorized signers are honest and will not collude.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: 51% attack: colluding signers can reorganize the chain, censor transactions, and modify the signer set arbitrarily.

implicit_assumptions.description: Signers have reasonably synchronized clocks within the BLOCK_PERIOD tolerance.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clock skew could cause valid blocks to be rejected or allow timestamp manipulation attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Signer private keys are securely stored and not compromised.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised keys allow attackers to produce valid blocks, potentially up to the signing limit.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot prevent honest signers from propagating blocks (no sustained network partition).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network partition could allow minority attackers to create competing chains in isolated segments.
